newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Piltel accepts resignation of directors.
newsitem.headline: Piltel accepts resignation of directors.

text.p: Pilipino Telephone Corp said on Friday it has accepted the resignation of two members of its board.
Piltel directors Roberto Anonas and Cesar Zalamea have resigned as members of the board effective immediately, the company said in a statement.
Former Trade and Industry Secretary Roberto Ongpin and Mario Locsin were elected on Thursday to serve the unexpired portion of the terms of Anonas and Zalamea this year, Piltel said.
Ongpin and Locsin are both board members of holding company APC Group Inc.
APC's telecom unit, Philippine Global Communications Inc (Philcom), recently bought a more than 20 percent stake in Piltel.
